reviews.quote: I arrived at my appointment time and both bays at this service center were in use.  I thought I would have a long wait - but the mechanic told me he would get right on it.  He did!  I was very pleased because there was no air conditioned waiting room and I had to sit out side.  The only thing I failed to realize was that the groupon price was for regular oil and my car uses synthetic.  So there was an additional $30 charge.

faqs.question: What service options are available at Wilke Automotive for this deal?
faqs.answer: Wilke Automotive offers two options under this deal: a Conventional Oil Change with 29 Point Inspection, and a Wheel Alignment service. Both options are available at the 3 North Wilke Road location in Arlington Heights, IL.

faqs.question: What does the 29 Point Inspection cover during the oil change at Wilke Automotive?
faqs.answer: The oil change options at Wilke Automotive include a comprehensive 29 Point Inspection performed alongside the conventional oil change. This inspection is part of the service offering at the 3 North Wilke Road location.

faqs.question: Does the Conventional Oil Change at Wilke Automotive cover vehicles that use synthetic oil?
faqs.answer: The deal at Wilke Automotive covers a conventional oil change only. Customers whose vehicles require synthetic oil have reported incurring an additional charge beyond the standard deal price.

faqs.question: Where is Wilke Automotive located, and what area does it serve?
faqs.answer: Wilke Automotive is located at 3 North Wilke Road in Arlington Heights, IL 60005, situated in the Golden Corridor area. This is the redemption location for all deal options, including the oil change and wheel alignment services.
